The parsed instance coordinate list is compared with axis defaults; when the input omits the default instance this condition selects the synthesis path.
The implementation increases the public named-instance count to account for a synthesized default instance not actually present in the fvar instance records.
The adjusted instance count is recovered from style_flags and used to size the in-memory MM variation structures.
The normalized coordinates array is sized for the adjusted instance count, but only the real fvar records are normalized; the synthesized default entry is not initialized in this array.

The missing default instance is materialized as an extra namedstyle entry after the input's real instance array.
